items.title: Amour
items.blurb: Ten nails on one theme — hearts poured in jelly red, a soda bottle and a love letter built up in relief, and a gingham bow sculpted by hand.
items.image_alt: A flat-lay of ten handmade press-on nails in red and white, with sculpted hearts, a bow, a soda bottle and love-letter details.

items.title: Fleur
items.blurb: Lilies, blossom and leaf worked in three dimensions over sage and blush, each flower laid on petal by petal before the top coat goes on.
items.image_alt: A flat-lay of ten handmade press-on nails in sage green and blush pink with sculpted three-dimensional flowers and leaves.
